findings: All 26 repair targets have direct singleton source joins; source identity aliases do not themselves supply territorial approval.

Boven Digoel and Merauke have retained topology-cut metadata despite zero interior rings; absence of rings cannot establish absence of exclusions.
Kiunga Rural has two retained interior rings and two recorded topology conflicts; Lake Murray has one recorded topology conflict.
Kaimana, Nabire and Teluk Wondama preserve IDN ADM1/ADM2 vintage and parent mismatch context; no parent clipping or additional competing-location claim is inferred.
Repair/physical subset rows contain no PNG source feature; complete PNG products remain competitor context from previous source analysis.
Merauke repair subset includes 105 retained inland-water cells; physical water is not automatically a territorial exclusion.
Current ownership receipt leaves all 49939 scoped cells unassigned at the accepted head; this is ownership accounting only.

Physical support classifications retain their source vintage/coverage limits; source-relative candidates remain unclassified.
